policy: Both computational functions are copied verbatim. Tutorials vary existing call arguments only.

fixed_core.sum: weighted sum, no division by N

limitations: Negative spike times are retained by the original generator and NumPy negative indices wrap to the record end.
Background trains draw a finite batch of exponential intervals.
Changing active_num changes random-number consumption for subsequent neurons.
Changing background_freq changes the finite ISI batch size and random-number consumption for later background neurons.
